unprovisioned_interpreter_cannot_resolve.containment: The canonical bootstrap is scripts/dev/provision_python_distribution.py; validation.commands[13] remains the negative control and TestAC2ModesUnderInstalledDistribution provisions its own interpreter when needed.
unprovisioned_interpreter_cannot_resolve.description: A bare interpreter from a foreign cwd cannot import a checkout that has not been installed. This is expected and proves the governed distribution is load-bearing.
unprovisioned_interpreter_cannot_resolve.expiry: When Python can import arbitrary uninstalled checkouts, which is not a project objective.
